lineageDetails.sqlQuery:
INSERT INTO dim.dim_incident_type
WITH a AS (
    SELECT
        CorpTypeID,
        dt,
        TypeCode,
        SUBSTRING(TypeCode, 1, LENGTH(TypeCode) - 4) AS TypeCode1,
        SUBSTRING(TypeCode, 1, LENGTH(TypeCode) - 8) AS TypeCode2,
        SUBSTRING(TypeCode, 1, LENGTH(TypeCode) - 12) AS TypeCode3,
        TypeName,
        IsTreeRoot
    FROM ods.ods_erp_tb_hspr_corpincidenttype_f_d
    WHERE IsTreeRoot = 0
    AND dt = (SELECT MAX(dt) FROM ods.ods_erp_tb_hspr_corpincidenttype_f_d)
)
SELECT
    a.CorpTypeID AS type_id,
    a.dt,
    a.TypeCode AS type_code,
    a.TypeName AS type_name,
    a.TypeCode1 AS type_code_1,
    b.TypeName AS type_name_1,
    a.TypeCode2 AS type_code_2,
    c.TypeName AS type_name_2,
    a.TypeCode3 AS type_code_3,
    d.TypeName AS type_name_3,
    a.IsTreeRoot AS is_tree_root
FROM a
LEFT JOIN ods.ods_erp_tb_hspr_corpincidenttype_f_d AS b
    ON a.TypeCode1 = b.TypeCode AND b.dt = a.dt
LEFT JOIN ods.ods_erp_tb_hspr_corpincidenttype_f_d AS c
    ON a.TypeCode2 = c.TypeCode AND c.dt = a.dt
LEFT JOIN ods.ods_erp_tb_hspr_corpincidenttype_f_d AS d
    ON a.TypeCode3 = d.TypeCode AND d.dt = a.dt
ORDER BY a.TypeCode

INSERT INTO dim.dim_customer
SELECT
    CustID AS cust_id,
    dt,
    CommID AS comm_id,
    CustName AS cust_name,
    CASE
        WHEN livetype1 = 1 THEN '业主'
        WHEN livetype2 = 2 THEN '租户'

        ELSE '其他'
    END AS live_type,
    CASE
        WHEN CustName LIKE '%项目物业减免' THEN '项目物业减免'
        WHEN (
            CustName LIKE '郑州元龙%'
            OR CustName LIKE '河南升龙%'

            OR CustName LIKE '郑州中元%'

            OR CustName LIKE '洛阳升龙%'

            OR CustName LIKE '洛阳海晨%'
            OR CustName LIKE '济源升龙%'

lineageDetails.sqlQuery:
INSERT INTO dim.dim_room
SELECT
    a.RoomID AS room_id,
    a.dt,
    a.CommID AS comm_id,
    a.RoomSign AS room_sign,
    a.RoomName AS room_name,
    b.BuildName AS build_name,
    a.BuildSNum AS build_snum,
    a.UnitSNum AS unit_snum,
    a.FloorSNum AS floor_snum,
    a.RoomSNum AS room_snum,
    a.BuildArea AS build_area,
    a.PropertyUses AS property_uses,
    a.RoomState AS room_state,
    a.UsesState AS uses_state
FROM ods.ods_erp_tb_hspr_room_f_d a
LEFT JOIN ods.ods_erp_tb_hspr_building_f_d b on a.BuildSNum = b.BuildSNum and a.CommID = b.CommID and  b.dt = (SELECT MAX(dt) FROM ods.ods_erp_tb_hspr_building_f_d)
WHERE a.dt = (SELECT MAX(dt) FROM ods.ods_erp_tb_hspr_room_f_d)
and a.CommID in (select comm_id from dim.dim_community)

INSERT INTO dim.dim_incident_type
WITH a AS (
    SELECT
        CorpTypeID,
        dt,
        TypeCode,
        SUBSTRING(TypeCode, 1, LENGTH(TypeCode) - 4) AS TypeCode1,
        SUBSTRING(TypeCode, 1, LENGTH(TypeCode) - 8) AS TypeCode2,
        SUBSTRING(TypeCode, 1, LENGTH(TypeCode) - 12) AS TypeCode3,
        TypeName,
        IsTreeRoot
    FROM ods.ods_erp_tb_hspr_corpincidenttype_f_d
    WHERE IsTreeRoot = 0
    AND dt = (SELECT MAX(dt) FROM ods.ods_erp_tb_hspr_corpincidenttype_f_d)
)
SELECT
    a.CorpTypeID AS type_id,
    a.dt,
    a.TypeCode AS type_code,
    a.TypeName AS type_name,
    a.TypeCode1 AS type_code_1,
    b.TypeName AS type_name_1,
    a.TypeCode2 AS type_code_2,
    c.TypeName AS type_name_2,
    a.TypeCode3 AS type_code_3,
    d.TypeName AS type_name_3,
    a.IsTreeRoot AS is_tree_root
FROM a
LEFT JOIN ods.ods_erp_tb_hspr_corpincidenttype_f_d AS b
    ON a.TypeCode1 = b.TypeCode AND b.dt = a.dt
LEFT JOIN ods.ods_erp_tb_hspr_corpincidenttype_f_d AS c
    ON a.TypeCode2 = c.TypeCode AND c.dt = a.dt
LEFT JOIN ods.ods_erp_tb_hspr_corpincidenttype_f_d AS d
    ON a.TypeCode3 = d.TypeCode AND d.dt = a.dt
ORDER BY a.TypeCode
